title: How does the world's skinniest skyscraper stand? Steinway Tower, 435 m tall and 18 m wide
description:
Steinway Tower at 111 West 57th Street, New York, is about 435 m tall and 18 m wide, a slenderness of about 24:1. A tuned mass damper above the highest floor counters sway of up to about 0.9 m, while two concrete shear walls and about 200 rock anchors give it stiffness and grip.

Sources: HowStuffWorks; KSL, 18 Aug 2022; Architectural Record, 4 May 2021. Home prices converted to rupees at about ₹78.6 per US dollar (2022, approx.). Scale and cutaway shots are AI visualisation. Photos: Brett Wharton, Parrish Freeman / Unsplash. Educational content.
